doc: Runtime gates are of four kinds: `check`, a product function by name; `evidence`; `review`, by a role that did not write the draft; `manual`, by a person. None is a command: the harness runs none of them.

gates.name: the text passes the product's lint
every ingredient name is a reference name or listed as unmatched
the text is not a copy of another
every number and claim cites a fact
evidence: the facts each claim rests on

gates.name: the brand and law guardian passed it
the proofreader passed it, reading only the draft
a person accepted it
gates.note: A person: the product's owner, or someone they name. No role accepts.

lanes.doc: A product card, before a person accepts it.
A letter or promotion, before a person accepts it.
